Download HSC image cutout

Parameters:

  • dec (float) – declination

  • cutout_size (float) – cutout size in arcsec

  • img_type (str) – ‘coadd’ (bkg-subtracted) or ‘coadd/bkg’ (coadd with background)

astrokit.datasets.query.query_NED(ra, dec, sep=3, raw=False)

query NED for the object with given ra and dec

Parameters:

  • ra (float) – right ascension in degree

  • raw (bool) – return the raw result from NED. Default is False
